name: Arcane Atlatl
description:
When used to throw a javelin, harpoon or similar thrown ranged weapon, double the weapon's range.

Once per day, you may spend a half action to touch the runes on the atlatl, activating its magical properties. For the next minute, the first attack you make with it carries magical force with it. On a hit, the thrown weapon deals an additional 1d4 damage and the target is knocked prone.
